messages.text: But your staff already approved the refund. What happened?

The earlier statement that a supervisor approved it was not verified. The request was reviewed and rejected by a staff member, who said the return packaging inspection was not satisfactory. Under the process, confirmation is followed by staff review, and the rejection reason is what I must relay. (refund-policy/v2/approval)
